result.reason: The added vendor indemnity prongs generally track the preferred substantive risks, but the clause does not expressly require TrueLink to defend, does not limit coverage to third-party claims, and includes no notice, control, or cooperation procedure. The Client indemnity remains incomplete and is not affirmatively limited to Client-provided content and Client's breach of law. It also does not meet the fallback because it lacks the usual IP exclusions and remedies and any 3× annual-fees super-cap. The unqualified scope may extend beyond third-party claims, so the revision is not narrowly calibrated, and the duplicated “harmless” wording and incomplete Client provision reduce drafting quality.
